visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Interior of a moving vehicle with bright natural daylight outside. A middle-aged man with a black cap and black t-shirt is sitting in the back seat, resting his head on his hand. Beside him, an older woman with short black hair wears sunglasses and a blue uniform-style vest over a white shirt. (2) Exterior shot of a local restaurant with a large sign reading '鐵道羊肉'. This is followed by a close-up of raw, sliced red mutton on a white plate, and then a steaming bowl of mutton soup with shredded ginger and greens in a casual indoor restaurant. (3) Inside a restaurant with simple wooden walls. A young woman with long pigtails, glasses, and a white baseball cap is sitting at a round wooden table with the middle-aged man. She uses chopsticks to pick up food from a small bowl. (4) Close-up on the young woman's face as she tastes the mutton. Her eyes widen and she covers her mouth with her hand, showing a shocked and slightly repulsed expression while chewing. The man watches her with a grin. (5) The middle-aged man takes a bite of mutton from his bowl, chews slowly, and looks satisfied. He gestures with his hand and nods to the camera, indicating the food is excellent. The restaurant lighting is bright and consistent.
